About COD

What is COD?

COD – Collaborative Ontology Development is an Intelligent Collaborative Labeling and Decentralized Platform that establishes Digital Trust in the Definition and Evaluation of Services, Products, and Content by combining Generative AI, Advanced Machine Learning, and Collective Intelligence at Scale.

COD Gamification

Build Your Credibility

CODers earn Credibility and CODCoins based on the accuracy of their evaluations. Higher credibility on specific evaluation aspects makes their voice more influential when evaluating similar services, products, or content. The weight of their vote on each aspect is calculated by our algorithm based on their demonstrated expertise.

With higher Credibility in specific areas, CODers can exchange their CODCoins for real money through their wallet. More accurate evaluations lead to greater earning potential.

Expertise Levels

For every evaluation that a CODer contributes, they receive an Expertise Level Badge.

COD WebApp

1

No Installation Required

COD is accessible on www.cod.ooo through any browser on your device. Simply click and start your journey evaluating services, products, and content.

2

Sign Up & In

Join for free using your email address and the Pin-Code provided to your verified email. Quick, secure, and ready to go in seconds.

3

COD Explorer

Discover and explore products, services, profiles, and content evaluated on the platform. Search by title or filter by characteristics to find what interests you.

4

Evaluation Aspects

Review comprehensive evaluation details including title, type, community, information, social connections, reference links, and different label categories that entities can be evaluated by.

5

Vote & Contribute

Vote on evaluation aspects using thumbs up or thumbs down to agree or disagree with relevance. Add new aspects you think are more relevant to help improve evaluations.

6

Track Credibility

Check your earned or lost credibility on each aspect you contributed to. Access your credibility dashboard from the bottom navigation on mobile or side menu on desktop.

7

Manage Wallet

Monitor your earned CODCoins and completed missions on your wallet page. Access it from the bottom navigation on mobile or side menu on desktop to manage your earnings.

8

Earn With Missions

Receive invitations to missions where you give feedback on specific aspects, earning real money in exchange. More credible CODers earn more for their honest feedback.

9

Join Communities

Connect with communities organized by brand where services and content are evaluated. Join public communities for free or get invited to private ones. Access via bottom navigation on mobile or side menu on desktop.
